item.title: Not The Kind Of Ride Where You Can Take A Backseat
item.description: Read Not The Kind Of Ride Where You Can Take A Backseat Me: "Hi there, sir. Just a quick heads-up that some guests find this ride a bit uncomfortable, depending on body shape and the restraint design. I just want to make sure you have the best experience." Customer: "Are you calling me fat?" Read Not The Kind Of Ride Where You Can Take A Backseat

item.title: Ignorance Is A Grill Thing
item.description: Read Ignorance Is A Grill Thing Customer's Son: "What's that yellow stuff?" Me: "Excuse me, sir, what yellow stuff?" Customer's Son: "That yellow stuff you're putting all over the burger." Read Ignorance Is A Grill Thing

item.title: The Benjamin Button Bar Crawl
item.description: Read The Benjamin Button Bar Crawl As we pull up, it hits me that I don't have my license with me. I wasn't the driver, so I didn't think to grab it. We're a ways away from the house, so I feel bad having ruined the trip, as we will have to go back, get my ID, then come back to the store again. Read The Benjamin Button Bar Crawl

item.title: Change Of Mind
item.description: Read Change Of Mind Customer: "Counting difficult for you, eh?" Me: "Hehe, math was never my strongest subject." Customer: "That's why you ended up in a dead-end retail job instead of going to college." Read Change Of Mind

item.title: Purple Rain
item.description: Read Purple Rain I'm in a local convenience store and pharmacy, also in my college town, when a young college-aged guy comes up to the counter. He has a purple soda (I forget which, likely grape) and some Ipecac (back when it used to be sold). Customer: "How much of this do I need to take to hurl?" Read Purple Rain
